title: SM-GOV-001: read-only Master Re-baseline
authority: Read repository metadata/source and existing CI using the authorized connector; produce a report in conversation only. No mutation in first round.
out_of_scope: Source changes, branches, commits, PR creation, merges, settings, deployment and runtime claims.
task: Inspect live repository and candidate source; produce baseline and propose roadmap without writing it.
validation: Read official tree, branch/PR heads, instructions, architecture, CI state and rulesets; declare unavailable execution.
stop_conditions: Repository/source mismatch, credentials exposure, attempted mutation or unsupported execution.
success_criteria: Attributable read-only baseline with exact official/candidate sources and truthful unknowns.
